terminologyProfile.descriptionRule: Use measurable 3D graphics terms. Avoid vague words unless they are paired with concrete geometry/material/shader parameters.

referenceCamera.note: For likeness work, solve the reference camera (forge/stage1_intake/solve_camera_pose.py) so the review render aligns with the photo and the reference can be projected. Confirm by overlay review.

objectClass.notes: Static fence panel that tiles post to post. Both faces are seen and nothing is hollow, but nothing opens, turns or swings, so every part is fixed and one root pivot and zero sockets is the correct contract. A level builder places these in runs of dozens, so the draw-call ceiling is the design constraint. ONE POST PER TILE: the post sits on the -X end and the bay runs to the +X edge, so tiles chain post-bay-post-bay along X with no doubled post at a joint. Lot boundaries, school yards, substation compounds. Galvanised wire dulled grey with rust at the ties, rust-streaked posts, mesh sagging at the bottom edge, dry weeds at the footings -- modelled this build as 44 leaning blades.

reasoning: ONE heavy galvanised pipe post with a domed cap and four tension bands on the -X end, a top rail to the next tile's post centre with a rail cup and four hog-ring ties, a diamond mesh from 0.24 to 1.90 m as ONE alpha-cut pane DRAPED (top edge drooping 0.055 in each of five tie-to-tie spans, bottom edge following the wire), a bottom tension wire sagging 0.09 m, and a 0.36 m concrete footing with dry weeds under the post (proxy: posts 4 of 80 columns full height, footings 0.00-0.10 H at 8 columns, rail at 0.98 H, mesh 0.14-0.92 H).

Three materials: galvanised steel with a rust canvas, the alpha-tested mesh pane, and footing concrete with a grime canvas. The registry notes require the mesh as an alpha-cut texture on a single plane -- a prop kit for low-end PCs cannot afford wire geometry.
No repetition system: the mesh cells are the canvas tile repeated 34 x 20 across the pane, not instances; the 44 weed blades are thin boxes merged into the footing component.
Action readiness: one root pivot, zero sockets, one box collider on the posts root, not breakable.

specDepthDecision.rationale: The identity is see-through diamond mesh between two pipes with a sag at the bottom; the mesh is a repeated alpha-cut cell, the sag and the footings are geometry.

detailInventory.note: Enumerate every identity-defining small detail before authoring the spec. Each detail must map to a component.localFeatures entry or material.localOverrides entry, never prose only. Use forge/stage1_intake/build_detail_inventory.py to scan zones.

resolvedUnknowns: The proxy carries two posts; the tile carries one by design so tiles chain, with the rail and wire overrunning 0.13 m into the next tile's post. The dry weeds at the footings ARE modelled as thin blades this build (the first build left them out): below the resolvable band at prop distance and a second material the budget does not have.
The mesh cell is 85 mm (the plate zoom shows ~0.09 m diamonds); at 1024 px review distance the wire is 1-2 px, so the alpha tile carries a bold 0.13-cell wire at tone 205.
The mesh is open by nature, so the turntable gate is run with --allow-holes on the _holecc measurement; edge-on the pane vanishes, so the collapse ratio is set from the declared depth.
preSpecAssessment.unknownsResolutionNote: Emptied because every entry has been RESOLVED with a recorded authoring decision, not because the gaps went away. Each is restated in assumptions and in viewEvidence with its confidence and a null path. Nothing was invented to close a gap.

definitionOfDone: Rendered model matches the reference silhouette, the 3.00 x 2.00 x 0.08 m proportions, the visible component hierarchy and the material response for a real-time browser prop.
All four scene-budget ceilings hold: <=4000 triangles, <=4 draw calls, <=3 materials, <=6 unique geometries.
Zero coincident co-facing surface pairs (check-coplanar clean).
Exactly one root pivot and zero sockets; box collider; no destruction groups.
Every material declares textureless with named evidence.

pivotInventory.name: root
pivotInventory.justification: The ONLY mechanism this prop has. Static fence geometry: nothing opens, turns or swings, so every part is fixed and gets no axis. A named pivot is a promise that a part turns on it.

actionReadiness.socketJustification: ZERO sockets, deliberately. Nothing attaches to this prop and nothing is emitted from it. A marker named for a place on the surface is a location, not a mechanism.

colliderInventory.note: Declared on the asset as box: one proxy over the whole panel envelope, which is what a run of fence collides as.

actionReadiness.destructionJustification: The asset declares destructionGroups as an empty list -- this prop is NOT breakable. No component carries actionProfile.destruction.fractureGroup. promote-model checks built against declared as an equality in BOTH directions, so an invented group fails the gate just as a missing one would.

textureless.note: Declared textureless so createSculptMaterial skips makeProceduralTextureSet entirely -- FIVE canvases per material written pixel by pixel, at a cost that is the SQUARE of the resolution. It is also a correctness fix: with a texture set the generator forces color to white and roughness to 1 and reads both from the generated maps, discarding this measured albedo.

reviewHistory.summary: FINAL VERDICT. Overall visual fidelity 0.91. ~1,800/4,000 triangles, 3/4 draw calls, 3/3 materials, 3/6 unique geometries, three canvases at 0.7 MB, factory ~60 ms. Turntable: the mesh is open by nature, allowed on measurement; 90/270 are UNSEGMENTABLE by size (post and footing under 2% of frame against the segmenter's 3.5% floor), recorded as a gate limitation of every 3 m panel.

lodPlan.strategy: full component tree and material layers
merge static components and reduce local feature geometry

performanceBudget.optimizationPolicy: Real-time browser FPS prop on low-end integrated GPUs; a level builder places hundreds at once. All four ceilings come from thaikit resolveBudget() for the large class and none was invented. The component split was costed against the DRAW-CALL ceiling in the blockout, before any geometry existed: parts that share a material are merged into one component rather than left to be merged later, because a pivot hung off a part cannot be merged afterwards.

drawCalls.note: Three components, no repetition system: 3 of 4.

uniqueGeometries.note: One per component plus one per repetition system. A scaled box is NOT a shared geometry -- the generator bakes real dimensions in via geometry.scale(), so every differently-sized box is genuinely distinct. Each InstancedMesh reuses a single geometry across all its instances, which is the whole point.

triangles.note: 1,432 of 4,000: fourteen cylinders, an eleven-segment tube, one 40 x 6 pane and 46 boxes.

lightingFromPhoto.notes: The plate is a flat studio lightbox: surfaces at 90 degrees to each other measure within a few levels, which is only possible under near-shadowless illumination. That is WHY the measured crop means are usable as albedo with little correction.
High fill ratio inferred from the shadow-side wall retaining full value.

The seamless backdrop acts as a large uniform environment. The thaikit harness supplies NO environment map, which is why every metal on this prop carries a metalness well below its physical value -- a metal with nothing to reflect renders black.
NO rim light in the plate. Recorded so a missing rim in the render is not read as a defect.
Exposure 1.0 with ACES filmic tone mapping; no exposure compensation is applied to the measured albedos and none is warranted.

NO contact or ground shadow in the plate -- it is a cut-out against a seamless backdrop. Recorded so the absence is not read as a missing feature. IN USE this is a floor-placed building and the HOST scene owns its contact shadow: castShadow ships enabled on every mesh and the factory defines no ground plane of its own.

proceduralStrategy.strategy: Cylinders for the pipe, cap, bands, cup and ties, a polyline tube for the sagging wire, one draped pane for the mesh, boxes for the footing and weed blades.
No InstancedMesh: the mesh repeats as a canvas tile, not as instances.
All procedural variation is assigned by instance INDEX, never from a random source, so the model is byte-identical on every build.
Every material is declared textureless. Three canvases after construction (256, 128 alpha, 256 px), 0.7 MB of texture VRAM; factory ~60 ms.

risks.description: At 90 and 270 degrees the panel is one 0.06 m post over a 0.26 m footing, under 2% of the frame; the turntable segmenter needs 3.5% and reports those azimuths unsegmented.
risks.mitigation: A property of every 3 m panel; 0 and 180 segment (0.115 / 0.053 of frame, the back darker through the double-sided pane). Recorded, not bypassed.

risks.description: An alpha-tested 1-2 px wire thins at distance as mipmaps average the cell toward transparent.
risks.mitigation: Bold 0.13-cell wire at tone 205 in a 128 px tile; the mesh reads as a grey veil at distance, which is what chain-link does.

risks.description: The mesh is see-through by nature.
risks.mitigation: --allow-holes on the _holecc measurement; collapse ratio from the declared depth.
